summary: Verified FIPAV level classification bug fix. All 6 backend tests passed: 'Prima Divisione Femminile' is now correctly classified as 'upper' and increments upper_league_presences. Other variants (Serie C, Serie D Maschile, 1^ Divisione) also classify as upper. 'Under 14/16' remain 'category' (do NOT increment upper counter, but count in camp3_presences_count and weekly_summary). Upper entries are counted BOTH in upper_league_presences AND weekly_summary.max_in_any_week. GET self-heal returns consistent levels. Duplicate-date block (400) still active.
critical_code_review_comments: classify_fipav_level: robust normalization (unicode NFKD, replaces ^/°/ª, lowercase). Recognizes 'serie c', 'serie d' and 'divisione' + ('prima' or 1/1a). Good coverage.
Consider also matching 'terza divisione'? Not required per spec (only 1^ upper); Seconda/Terza correctly fall to 'category'.
_recompute_levels applied on both GET and POST — good self-heal for legacy entries.
seed_data_creation: Tests auto-cleanup all game_presences at setup and teardown (MARCO registry emptied).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response uses 'token' key (not 'access_token'). MARCO athlete registry left clean.
rca of the issue: Prior code used exact set match UPPER_LEAGUE_SET={'Serie C','Serie D','1^ Divisione'}, missing variants like 'Prima Divisione Femminile'. Fix normalizes and pattern-matches. Verified upper_league_presences now increments correctly.
